title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
content:
Q: How do I choose my shoe size?
A: FootFlex uses UK/India sizing. Size charts with length in centimeters are available on each product page. If you are between sizes, we recommend selecting one size larger.

Q: Are all shoes authentic?
A: Yes, 100% of products sold on FootFlex are authentic, quality-tested footwear.

Q: How can I contact customer support?
A: You can reach us via email at support@footflex.com or through live chat from Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 6 PM IST.
